explication: containerd is a daemon and embedded container runtime managing image/content transfer, persistent metadata, mounts, sandboxes, tasks, and runtime supervision. Operators or Kubernetes clients enter through client/API or CRI surfaces; requests reach lifecycle services, which create and start sandboxes through shim processes and runc, while state is persisted and events are published. The graph emphasizes this workflow and documented storage, transfer, streaming, leases, and snapshot capabilities. Several service registrations and unsampled implementations are represented only where their paths are explicit in the tree.
